# Steps along three axes

Original synthetic Apache-2.0 fixture for #307 (item 10), generated by
`tools/make_multi_axis_step_fixture.py` with build123d 0.13.0. No customer geometry is used.

`multi_axis_steps.step.gz` is three stacked blocks: 50 × 60 × 40 (X 0..50), 50 × 40 × 20
(X 50..100) and 20 × 20 × 10 (X 100..120), all from Y 0 and Z 0. Read in file coordinates with no
other family's claims, it has levels along Z (Z 10 and 20), along Y (Y 20 and 40) and along X
(X 100), each face in exactly one level; the X 50 wall spans the part's width and stays a riser
of the Z steps. In its inferred frame the part is a plate with a pocket and a pad, which claim
those faces, so no level along the frame's x or y is published there.
